title: High-Frequency CVE Second-Generation List (2024-2026)
description: Common recent attack/defense assessment targets and Chinese admin-panel suites
detail: High frequency: GitLab CVE-2023-7028 password reset takeover; Confluence CVE-2023-22527 template injection; OFBiz unauthenticated deserialization; JumpServer session RCE. Chinese admin panels: RuoYi (scheduled task RCE), JeecgBoot (Freemarker SSTI), XXL-Job (default token executor RCE). Approach: identify the product first (404 page/static resource characteristics) → use the standard exploit chain → for targets requiring login, try default credentials first such as admin/admin123/ruoyi123.
